notes.subject: רב
notes.rationale: Read as verb רבב 'he shot (lightnings)' (KJV 'shot out lightnings') vs adjective 'many lightnings' (ASV 'lightnings manifold')

notes.subject: ויהמם
notes.rationale: Literally 'he set them in commotion' — 'discomfited/routed' is the role reading; Tok Pisin keeps the commotion picture

translation: Na em i salim ol aro bilong en na em i skalima ol, na sutim ol braunlight olgeta, na em i mekim guria na bagarapim ol.
